metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse and clashes with Spider-Society.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

metas.name: Venom
metas.description: A journalist bonds with an alien symbiote that gives him deadly powers.

metas.name: Venom: The Last Dance
metas.description: Eddie and Venom go on the run from both their worlds in their final chapter.

metas.name: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
metas.description: Four teens are sucked into a video game as its adult avatars.

metas.name: Uncharted
metas.description: Nathan Drake hunts Magellan's lost gold with mentor Sully.

metas.name: Madame Web
metas.description: A paramedic's clairvoyance connects her to three young women in danger.

metas.name: Morbius
metas.description: A doctor's cure for his blood disease turns him into a living vampire.

metas.name: Kraven the Hunter
metas.description: The hunter becomes the hunted in this Spider-Man villain origin.

metas.name: Gran Turismo
metas.description: A gamer becomes a real race car driver in this true story.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: Five assassins collide on a high-speed train in Tokyo.
